forms.ex: Was hat der Arzt gestern gesagt?
forms.exEn: What did the doctor say yesterday?

forms.en: cancel (an appointment, an event); decline (an invitation)
forms.why: ab = off: you call something off.
forms.ex: Ich muss den Termin leider absagen.
forms.exEn: Unfortunately I have to cancel the appointment.

forms.ex: Leider habe ich wieder eine Absage bekommen.
forms.exEn: Unfortunately I got another rejection.

forms.en: accept (an invitation, an offer), say yes; promise; appeal to (someone)
forms.why: zu = to, toward: you say yes to someone.
forms.ex: Ich habe für die Party am Samstag zugesagt.
forms.exEn: I've said yes to the party on Saturday.

forms.en: acceptance; offer (of a job, a place); promise
forms.ex: Ich habe eine Zusage von der Firma bekommen!
forms.exEn: I got an offer from the company!

forms.why: aus = out: you say out what you know.
forms.ex: Die Zeugin will vor Gericht nicht aussagen.
forms.exEn: The witness doesn't want to testify in court.

forms.ex: Diese Aussage des Politikers ist einfach falsch.
forms.exEn: This statement by the politician is simply false.

forms.why: kräftig = strong: data that make a strong statement.
forms.ex: Die Zahlen sind leider nicht sehr aussagekräftig.
forms.exEn: Unfortunately the figures don't tell us much.

forms.en: announce (a song, a guest); forecast (rain); angesagt: trendy
forms.clue: to announce (the next song, a guest)
forms.why: an = at the start: you say what comes next.
forms.ex: Der Moderator sagt das nächste Lied an.
forms.exEn: The presenter announces the next song.

forms.ex: Ich habe die Ansage am Telefon nicht verstanden.
forms.exEn: I didn't understand the recorded message on the phone.

forms.clue: to pass a message over the PA (a delay)
forms.why: durch = through: the message goes through the loudspeaker to everyone.
forms.ex: Der Zugführer sagt durch, dass der Zug Verspätung hat.
forms.exEn: The guard announces over the PA that the train is delayed.

forms.clue: the PA message (e.g. about a delay)
forms.ex: Am Bahnhof gab es eine Durchsage zur Verspätung.
forms.exEn: There was an announcement about the delay at the station.

forms.why: Learn it as a word: the old sense 'say no, refuse' became 'fail'.
forms.ex: Bei der Prüfung haben meine Nerven versagt.
forms.exEn: My nerves failed me in the exam.

forms.ex: Die Ursache des Unfalls war menschliches Versagen.
forms.exEn: The cause of the accident was human error.

forms.ex: Nach der Prüfung fühlte er sich wie ein Versager.
forms.exEn: After the exam he felt like a failure.

forms.why: vorher = beforehand: you say what will happen before it happens.
forms.note: The particle is vorher (vor + her), stressed on her: vor-HER-sagen.
forms.ex: Die Experten haben den Sturm genau vorhergesagt.
forms.exEn: The experts forecast the storm exactly.

forms.ex: Laut Vorhersage wird es morgen sonnig.
forms.exEn: According to the forecast it will be sunny tomorrow.

forms.why: weiter = on, further: you say it on to the next person.
forms.ex: Das ist ein Geheimnis, bitte sag es nicht weiter!
forms.exEn: It's a secret, please don't tell anyone!

forms.why: Learn it as a word: unter- + say does not give 'forbid'.
forms.ex: Das Rauchen ist im ganzen Gebäude untersagt.
forms.exEn: Smoking is prohibited in the whole building.

forms.en: say, state, mean (a rule, a study)
forms.clue: to say (of a rule or text: 'The rule ___ that …')
forms.why: be- + say: a text or a rule says something.
forms.ex: Die Regel besagt, dass man pünktlich sein muss.
forms.exEn: The rule says that you have to be on time.

forms.en: say of someone (a rumour, a reputation); repeat (words)
forms.why: nach = after: people say things after you, behind your back.
forms.ex: Man sagt ihm nach, dass er sehr reich ist.
forms.exEn: He is said to be very rich.

forms.why: auf = up, out loud: you say the whole text out.
forms.ex: Das Kind sagt ein Gedicht auf.
forms.exEn: The child recites a poem.

forms.why: What people say and tell: an old story passed on by word of mouth.
forms.ex: Die Sage erzählt von einem Drachen im Berg.
forms.exEn: The legend tells of a dragon in the mountain.

forms.en: so to speak, as it were
forms.note: so zu sagen written as one word, stressed on sa: sozu-SA-gen.
forms.ex: Er ist sozusagen der Chef der Familie.
forms.exEn: He is the head of the family, so to speak.
